title: periploca khasiana
intro: Periploca khasiana, commonly known as Himalayan snake root, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Periploca khasiana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal efficacy.
